result:
The decisive mistake was made by **DataVerification_Expert** at **step 6**. It replaced the Selenium approach with a `requests` + BeautifulSoup scraper, claiming it "may be more stable." OpenReview renders its group pages with JavaScript, so a static HTTP fetch returns almost no paper data. The script also used guessed CSS selectors (`div.note`, `h3.title`, `span.recommendation`) without checking them against the site. The run reported success at step 7, but the resulting CSV was empty, as the `EmptyDataError` at step 9 shows. The analysis at step 8 then proceeded on that empty file, so the task could not be answered. The agent was supposed to verify the work but never checked that the output contained any rows.
